{{Quote|Track down the Nebula shipment, then find a way to divert it to Palliser Station, a Republic base near Corellia.|[[Darmas Pollaran]] to [[Voidhound]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Palliser Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located near [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was used as a base by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] [[Darmas Pollaran]] asked the [[Voidhound]] to divert the shipment of [[Project Nebula]] weapons from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] to the Palliser Station, though he kept his true motives for such a request secret.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
